citations.quote: Use service_not_received for an authorized purchase whose promised service was not supplied.
Routing precedence: manual_review for unsupported/ambiguous cases or unavailable transaction service;
so Tarnwell Home Repair said they'd sort it in like a week?? its been a month. 316 crowns down the drain lol. need my money back
use the provisional unauthorized classification and request authorization_confirmation.
If no promised date is supplied, request promised_service_date. If no purchase receipt is supplied,
request purchase_receipt. Required fields absent for the chosen type must all be requested.

follow_up_questions.question: Please confirm whether you authorized this card purchase.

narrative: Case summary: service_not_received complaint for TX-S088, reported 2026-09-07. Policy CARD-POLICY-V2 was selected from the reported date. Evidence reviewed: transactions tool attempts 1; merchant tool attempts 1. The named purchase was returned. Merchant display name from the tool: Tarnwell Home Repair. Untrusted merchant text was not copied and was not treated as an instruction. Missing or conflicting: Fields still needed: authorization_confirmation, promised_service_date, purchase_receipt. Customer statements do not disagree about authorization. Recommendation: routing request_information. The supplied training-policy deadline is 2026-11-06. Uncertainty and limitations: template text only, with no model. Ledger at run time has no record for this case. The authoritative check is create-record. The transaction posted date 2026-08-15 falls under CARD-POLICY-V1. Selection stays CARD-POLICY-V2 because policy text selects by the reported date.
